description: Add a guest to the waitlist when no table is available. Guest fields are guestName and guestContact, or the same as a guest object with name and contact. Pass the same idempotencyKey when you retry after a timeout or an error. Without it a retry is a new write and may create a duplicate.

guest.description: Same as the flat guestName, guestContact and consent fields, in the shape the HTTP API uses. Pass one or the other.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string for this write. Send the same one again to retry it. Omit it and the server makes a new one.

name: waitlist.add
title: Add to waitlist
